_note: Pin the FastVLM selector's model + framework so a run is reproducible. Fill fastvlm_commit / torch / checkpoint / checkpoint_sha256 from the provisioned venv (see docs/reproducible-runtime.md); run_manifest.model_provenance records these and, when POI_FASTVLM_CHECKPOINT is set, verifies the on-disk checkpoint against checkpoint_sha256. Null values are recorded verbatim and never fail a run.
